name: local-gpu-imagegen
description: Orchestrate catalog-gated, reviewable local visual asset runs.

interface.shortDescription: Brief and review catalog-gated local visual asset runs.
interface.longDescription: An Agent-native local visual asset control plane with adaptive briefing, bounded local model discovery, user-local trust, confirmed deterministic routing, reviewed checkpoint and split-model ComfyUI workflows, three visual Profiles, 1-to-3-round review workflows, immutable preserve/change revisions, and durable recovery. No model weights are bundled or downloaded implicitly. Model-free tests cover WebUI and ComfyUI adapter contracts. Real ComfyUI generation evidence remains local development validation rather than public acceptance evidence; the complete real 9+3 host/vision acceptance matrix is not retained.
defaultPrompt: Plan a catalog-gated local visual asset run.
Inspect local CUDA image generation readiness.
Prepare a reviewable local illustration run.
